text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Um, Ryan-senpai! Here's my Valentine's 
return gift!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
For Valentine's? Oh, today is White Day, 
isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, on Valentine's Day, 
if I recall...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You went around to the classrooms of all 
the girls who always support you and gave 
them chocolates, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I meant to return the favor for 
your cheers, but here you are giving me 
such a wonderful return gift again.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Still, eating this will give me the 
strength of a hundred! I'll savor every 
bite between training sessions with 
gratitude!"

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Mmm-hmmm♪

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ryan-senpai is always so wonderful. She 
never forgets to be considerate to 
everyone.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm, and on top of that, their 
interactions are so smooth! Makes me an 
even bigger fan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(Ahaha, suave... maybe? I feel like I'm 
just being ordinarily polite, though.)
choice_data_list:
Ryan! Here, your return gift for 
Valentine's Day!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer, you too. Thank you for going 
out of your way. I didn't mean to make you 
worry...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Wait... Trainer... for me...? Wh... 
Wh-Wh-What...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Pardon m--!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah... a-ah... What is this, what is it...? 
Calm down, my heart. Calm down~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Aaah, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
N-No, um... If it were just cheering from 
a fan, I could take it in stride, but~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I never expected to get something from 
you, Trainer... That's why my heart is 
beating so fast...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah, this happiness... I want to take it 
all in, but it's just overwhelming. Ah... 
ah... aah...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ryan didn't seem very used to 
receiving genuine affection.
choice_data_list:
Calm down, how about taking a moment to 
let it sink in?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Calm down... That's right. It's quite 
intense, so let's take it little by 
little...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(I see... Trainer remembered the 
Valentine's chocolate I gave them that 
night.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(Then could this be... not just an 
obligation... ?)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: No, no, no!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Someone like me, someone like me, someone 
like me! I'm not the kind of Umamusume who 
gets called in the First Call!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? I'm sorry... I just can't stop this 
overwhelming lack of confidence!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Deep breath... Take a deep breath... Once 
more...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(For instance, as an ideal vision for the 
future...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(A more confident, mature Umamusume. 
Someone who can lead at times, and gently 
support at others...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Believe in me, Trainer. Just as I believe 
in you from the bottom of my heart, okay?♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm so sorry! I got 
way ahead of myself! A lowly person such 
as myself, doing that...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hawawa, no no, this time my arrogance just 
can't be contained!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... I feel like I'm finally starting 
to get used to it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(I see... Trainer really is... accepting 
me for who I am...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(I see... You're not looking at me like 
I'm anyone else, but for who I really 
am...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: *Sigh*... I'm so happy... really...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"It feels like... the hole that I could 
never seem to fill until now... is finally 
being filled..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I'm happy... so very happy...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ryan embraced this unknown 
excitement... and seemed to bask in the 
joy of it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ah, McQueen. Got a sec?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh, Ryan. You seem, somehow...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You have quite the radiant look on your 
face today. Did something good happen?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah! It's like I discovered feelings I 
never knew I had...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh my, could you tell me more about that?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Mejiro Ryan had a lively girls' 
talk in the Mejiro family living room.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I'm happy, but... is this really okay...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While Mejiro Ryan accepted this unknown 
excitement... she still seemed a bit 
unsteady on her feet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —That night.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Um, Ines!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Ryan-chan, what's the matter? You're 
still awake?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, like, you know...!! I can't sleep at 
all, my eyes are wide awake!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Maybe I'll go for a quick run...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even knowing that sneaking out after 
lights-out was against the rules... Mejiro 
Ryan just wanted to sweat out those sweet, 
frustrating feelings through a good run.
